''''' Statistical Methods in Medical Research''''' is a [[Peer review|peer-reviewed]] [[academic journal]] that publishes papers in the fields of [[Health Care]] and [[Medical Informatics]]. The journal's [[editor-in-chief|editor]] is Brian Everitt ([[King's College London]]). It has been in publication since 1992 and is currently published by [[SAGE Publications]].

== Scope ==
''Statistical Methods in Medical Research'' is a scholarly journal which publishes articles in the main areas of medical statistics and it is also used as a reference for medical statisticians. The journal focuses solely on statistics and medicine and aims to keep professionals up to date with all statistical techniques.

== Abstracting and indexing ==
'' Statistical Methods in Medical Research'' is abstracted and indexed in, among other databases:  [[SCOPUS]], and the [[Social Sciences Citation Index]]. According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', its 2013 [[impact factor]] is 2.957, ranking it 14 out of 85 journals in the category ‘Health Care Sciences & Services’.,<ref name=WoS>{{cite book |year=2013 |chapter=Journals Ranked by Impact: Health Care Sciences & Services|title=2013 Journal Citation Reports |title-link=Journal Citation Reports|publisher=[[Thomson Reuters]] |edition= Sciences |work=Web of Science }}</ref> 5 out of 119 journals in the category ‘Statistics & Probability’.,<ref name=WoS1>{{cite book |year=2013 |chapter=Journals Ranked by Impact: Statistics & Probability|title=2013 Journal Citation Reports |title-link=Journal Citation Reports|publisher=[[Thomson Reuters]] |edition= Sciences |work=Web of Science }}</ref> 6 out of 52 journals in the category ‘Mathematical & Computational Biology’.<ref name=WoS2>{{cite book |year=2013 |chapter=Journals Ranked by Impact: Mathematical & Computational Biology |title=2013 Journal Citation Reports |title-link=Journal Citation Reports |publisher=[[Thomson Reuters]] |edition= Sciences |work=Web of Science }}</ref> and 3 out of 25 journals in the category ‘Medical Informatics’.<ref name=WoS3>{{cite book |year=2013 |chapter=Journals Ranked by Impact: Medical Informatics  |title=2013 Journal Citation Reports |title-link=Journal Citation Reports |publisher=[[Thomson Reuters]] |edition= Sciences |work=Web of Science }}</ref>
